title: Book 1 final test
intro: This final covers Lessons 1 to 30 across all four sections. Pass with 70% or higher.

questions.question: Which number is ‘dvadeset’?
questions.explanation: Dvadeset = twenty.

questions.question: A džezva is…
questions.explanation: Džezva is the little pot used for Bosnian coffee.

questions.question: The letter š sounds most like English…
questions.explanation: Š is like sh in ship. as in Baščaršija.

questions.question: Which possessive goes with ‘mačka’?
questions.explanation: Mačka is feminine → moja mačka.

questions.question: Which forms are ‘I am / you are / he is’?
questions.explanation: Biti in. Sam, si, je (Lesson 2).

questions.question: What does vrijeme mean?
questions.explanation: Vrijeme means weather.

questions.question: Which sentence means that it is cloudy?
questions.explanation: Oblačno je means that it is cloudy.

questions.question: Why can winter air pollution linger in Sarajevo?
options: An inversion can trap polluted air.
questions.explanation: A winter inversion can trap polluted air in the Sarajevo basin.

questions.question: What happens during Mrvica's park walk?
options: She tangles the leash around a tree.
questions.explanation: Mrvica tangles the leash around a tree.

questions.question: In the shopping listen clip, you mainly train…
options: Hearing price and want phrases in real teaching speech
questions.explanation: Čuj Bosnu here targets shop phrases.

questions.question: What does pravo mean in a direction?
questions.explanation: Pravo means straight ahead in a direction.

questions.question: Which chunk means I need a ticket?
questions.explanation: Treba mi karta means I need a ticket.

questions.question: What second landscape balances the football chat?
questions.explanation: Štrbački buk on the Una balances the chat.

questions.question: What religious change does the civic panel describe?
options: Gulf-funded mosque reconstruction that also shifted teaching toward more conservative lines
Only one faith may use city streets
No foreign money rebuilt any mosque
questions.explanation: Gulf donations rebuilt mosques such as the King Fahd Mosque and supported more conservative teaching streams.

questions.question: Which sentence orders klepe politely?
questions.explanation: Hoću klepe, molim is a polite order.

questions.question: What does torta mean?
questions.explanation: Torta means cake.

questions.question: Which line uses i correctly?
questions.explanation: Volim grad i učim bosanski links two facts with i.

questions.question: What civic topic does this lesson highlight?
options: Republika Srpska leaders challenge state judicial and police authority while floating secession
State courts control every local café menu
Police forces merged into one EU agency
questions.explanation: Secessionist rhetoric and resistance to state-level courts and police remain a documented structural pressure.

questions.question: Who speaks as the landlord in the dialogue?
questions.explanation: The landlord shows the kitchen and explains rent.

questions.question: What does apoteka mean?
questions.explanation: Apoteka means pharmacy.
